docs.text: Songloft 计算巢部署文档 服务说明 Songloft 是一款开源自托管的个人音乐服务器，使用 Go 编写、内置 SQLite，无外部数据库依赖。把自有音乐文件放进服务器的音乐目录，它会扫描并索引元数据与封面，生成一个通过网页访问的私人曲库；手机、电脑、电视等客户端连上同一台服务器即可播放。 本计算巢服务采用单机 ECS 部署，ECS 镜像内已预置 Songloft 与 Docker Compose 运行环境，曲库数据与音乐文件都保存在实例系统盘，不经过任何第三方存储服务。 需要注意：本服务不提供任何音乐内容，音乐目录出厂为空，需要自行上传合法拥有的音乐文件；上游文档声明适用于个人非商业使用，购买前请确认使用场景符合上游授权条款。 访问入口为实例公网 IP 的 58091 端口，用户名固定为 admin ，密码在部署时随机生成并展示在实例输出中。 计费说明 通过此服务模板构建服务不产生费用。用户部署服务实例时，资源费用主要涉及： ECS 实例规格（最低 2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存） 系统盘容量（模板固定 200 GiB ESSD） 公网带宽（模板固定 5 Mbps） 计费方式支持按量付费和包年包月，预估费用会在部署前实时展示。 RAM账号所需权限 若使用 RAM 用户创建服务实例，需要在创建服务实例前为该 RAM 用户添加相应权限。 权限策略名称 备注 AliyunECSFullAccess 管理云服务器 ECS 的权限 AliyunVPCFullAccess 管理专有网络 VPC 的权限 AliyunROSFullAccess 管理资源编排 ROS 的权限 AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess 管理计算巢服务用户侧资源的权限 服务实例部署流程 部署步骤 打开计算巢服务实例创建页面，选择部署地域，填写实例规格、实例密码。网络可选择新建 VPC，也可以选择已有的 VPC 与交换机。 部署链接 确认询价明细后点击 下一步：确认订单 ，同意服务协议并点击 立即创建 。 等待服务实例部署完成。部署完成后，在服务实例详情页的 输出 区域查看 songloft_58091_url 访问地址、 AdminUsername 用户名与 AdminPassword 管理员密码；输出中还有若干条使用说明（音乐目录、遥测、许可等），建议一并阅读。 用浏览器打开输出中的访问地址（ http://<实例公网IP>:58091 ），首次登录会要求勾选用户协议；使用用户名 admin 与输出中的管理员密码登录，即可进入首页。 首次使用说明 1. 上传音乐并扫描 音乐目录为实例上的 /opt/songloft/music （容器内对应 /app/music ，已预置在配置中，无需在设置页手工填写）。通过 SCP、SFTP 或 rsync 把音乐文件上传到该目录，然后在 设置 → 音乐库管理 点击 扫描本地音乐 ，封面与元数据会被自动提取入库。扫描支持 MP3、FLAC、WAV、APE、OGG、DSD 等常见格式。 2. 数据持久化 数据库、配置与封面缓存保存在 /opt/songloft/data ，音乐文件在 /opt/songloft/music 。执行 docker compose down 或重建容器不会丢数据；释放服务实例时两个目录会一并删除，请定期备份。 3. 修改管理员密码 系统未提供界面改密入口。如需更换密码，登录实例编辑 /opt/songloft/.env 中的 ADMIN_PASSWORD ，然后执行 cd /opt/songloft && docker compose up -d 重建容器生效。 4. 运行监控与出网 官方镜像在编译期注入了 Tracely 运行监控，上游隐私说明称会上报版本、运行平台、主机名与活跃心跳，当前版本没有运行期关闭开关。如需彻底阻断，请通过安全组或网络 ACL 限制实例的出方向访问。 5. 插件与升级 Subsonic 兼容接口、WebDAV 等能力以官方插件形式提供，未预置在镜像内，可在插件管理页上传对应插件包后启用；第三方插件的授权与内容合规由使用者自负。管理界面提供版本检查与 Docker 环境下的升级入口，升级前请先备份数据目录，并确认实例可访问上游分发源。 参数说明 参数 说明 默认值 VpcOption 网络类型，新建 VPC 或使用已有 VPC NewVPC VpcCidrBlock 新建 VPC 的网段 192.168.0.0/16 VSwitchCidrBlock 新建交换机的网段 192.168.1.0/24 EcsInstanceType ECS 实例规格，可选 2–4 vCPU 的 ecs.u1 / ecs.e 系列 无 InstancePassword 实例登录密码 无 PayType 付费类型 PostPaid ZoneId 可用区 无 VpcId / VSwitchId 已有 VPC 与交换机 ID（选择已有 VPC 时填写） 空 输出说明 输出 说明 songloft_58091_url 曲库访问地址（端口 58091） AdminUsername 管理员用户名（admin） AdminPassword 管理员密码（部署时随机生成） QuickStartGuide / MusicDirNote / DataPersistenceNote / PasswordNote 登录、音乐目录、数据持久化与改密说明 TelemetryNote / GplFfmpegNote / PluginNote / UpgradeNote / SourceLicenseNote 遥测出网、ffmpeg 许可、插件、升级与来源授权说明 安全与使用说明 请勿公开分享管理员密码；密码泄露后按上文方式在实例内更换。 曲库版权与合规由使用者自行负责，本服务不提供任何音乐内容。 主程序为 Apache-2.0 许可；镜像内 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe 以 GPL 选项构建，随镜像分发需遵循 GPL 要求。 本服务基于开源项目 Songloft 构建，与上游项目及作者无隶属或背书关系。 常见问题 登录后曲库是空的？ 音乐目录出厂为空。先把文件上传到 /opt/songloft/music ，再到设置页触发扫描。 扫描不到新上传的歌曲？ 确认文件放在 /opt/songloft/music 下且容器对该目录有读权限，然后重新触发扫描；修改过音乐目录的，需要在设置页更新目录后再扫描。 重启实例后数据还在吗？ 在。数据与音乐分别在 /opt/songloft/data 与 /opt/songloft/music ；只有释放服务实例才会删除。 官方链接 官方仓库：https://github.com/songloft-org/songloft 官方网站与文档：https://songloft.hanxi.cc/ 许可证：Apache-2.0（主程序）

docs.text: Deploying Songloft on Alibaba Cloud Compute Nest About the service Songloft is an open-source, self-hosted personal music server written in Go with a built-in SQLite database and no external database dependency. Point it at a folder of your own music files and it scans and indexes metadata and cover art, then serves the library through a web UI that phones, computers and TVs can connect to. This Compute Nest service deploys a single ECS instance. The image already contains Songloft and its Docker Compose runtime, and both the library database and the music files stay on the instance system disk. Note that this service ships no music content of any kind: the music directory is empty by default and you upload files you legally own. The upstream project states that it is intended for personal, non-commercial use, so confirm your scenario fits those terms before purchasing. Songloft is served on port 58091 of the instance public IP. The username is always admin ; the password is generated during deployment and listed in the service instance outputs. Billing Creating a service from this template is free. Running a service instance incurs: ECS instance (minimum 2 vCPU, 4 GiB memory) System disk (fixed at 200 GiB ESSD by the template) Public bandwidth (fixed at 5 Mbps by the template) Both pay-as-you-go and subscription are supported; the estimate is shown before you confirm the order. Required RAM permissions If you create the instance with a RAM user, grant the following policies first. Policy Purpose AliyunECSFullAccess Manage ECS instances AliyunVPCFullAccess Manage VPC resources AliyunROSFullAccess Manage Resource Orchestration Service stacks AliyunComputeNestUserFullAccess Manage Compute Nest user-side resources Deployment steps Open the instance creation page, choose a region, and specify the instance type and instance password. You can create a new VPC or use an existing VPC and vSwitch. Deploy now Review the price estimate, choose Next: Confirm Order , accept the service agreement and click Create Now . Wait for the deployment to finish. The Outputs section of the instance details page lists songloft_58091_url , AdminUsername and AdminPassword , plus several notes on the music directory, telemetry and licensing that are worth reading. Open the URL from the outputs ( http://<public-ip>:58091 ). The first sign-in asks you to accept the user agreement; then sign in as admin with the generated password to reach the home page. First steps Upload music and scan The music directory is /opt/songloft/music on the instance ( /app/music inside the container, already configured, so you do not need to fill it in on the settings page). Upload files with SCP, SFTP or rsync, then click Scan local music under Settings → Music library . Cover art and metadata are extracted automatically. MP3, FLAC, WAV, APE, OGG and DSD are among the supported formats. Data persistence The database, configuration and cover cache live in /opt/songloft/data ; music files live in /opt/songloft/music . docker compose down and container rebuilds keep the data; releasing the instance deletes both directories, so back them up regularly. Change the admin password There is no password change screen. Edit ADMIN_PASSWORD in /opt/songloft/.env on the instance, then run cd /opt/songloft && docker compose up -d to recreate the container. Runtime telemetry and outbound access The official image injects Tracely runtime monitoring at build time. The upstream privacy notice says it reports the version, runtime platform, hostname and activity heartbeat, and there is no runtime switch to turn it off in the current release. To block it entirely, restrict the instance's outbound traffic with security groups or network ACLs. Plugins and upgrades Capabilities such as the Subsonic-compatible API and WebDAV ship as official plugins rather than being bundled in the image; upload the corresponding plugin package on the plugin page to enable them. Licensing and content compliance for third-party plugins are the operator's responsibility. The admin UI offers a version check and an upgrade entry point for Docker deployments; back up the data directory first and make sure the instance can reach the upstream distribution source. Parameters Parameter Description Default VpcOption Create a new VPC or reuse an existing one NewVPC VpcCidrBlock CIDR block of the new VPC 192.168.0.0/16 VSwitchCidrBlock CIDR block of the new vSwitch 192.168.1.0/24 EcsInstanceType ECS instance type, 2–4 vCPU ecs.u1 / ecs.e families none InstancePassword Password for the ECS instance none PayType Billing method PostPaid ZoneId Availability zone none VpcId / VSwitchId Existing VPC and vSwitch (when reusing a VPC) empty Outputs Output Description songloft_58091_url Library URL (port 58091) AdminUsername Admin username ( admin ) AdminPassword Admin password (generated at deployment) QuickStartGuide / MusicDirNote / DataPersistenceNote / PasswordNote Sign-in, music directory, data persistence and password notes TelemetryNote / GplFfmpegNote / PluginNote / UpgradeNote / SourceLicenseNote Telemetry, ffmpeg licensing, plugins, upgrades and source licensing notes Security notes Do not share the admin password; if it leaks, change it as described above. You are responsible for the copyright and compliance of the music in the library. This service ships no music content. The main application is Apache-2.0 licensed; the bundled ffmpeg and ffprobe are built with GPL options, so redistributing the image must follow GPL terms. This service is built on the open-source Songloft project and has no affiliation with or endorsement from the upstream project or its authors. Troubleshooting The library is empty after sign-in. The music directory starts empty. Upload files to /opt/songloft/music and trigger a scan. Newly uploaded tracks are not found. Make sure the files are under /opt/songloft/music and readable by the container, then run the scan again. If you changed the music directory, update it on the settings page before scanning. Is data durable across restarts? Yes. Data and music live in /opt/songloft/data and /opt/songloft/music ; only releasing the instance deletes them. Links Source code: https://github.com/songloft-org/songloft Website and documentation: https://songloft.hanxi.cc/ License: Apache-2.0 (main application)

docs.title: Security notes

docs.text: The library is empty after sign-in. The music directory starts empty. Upload files to /opt/songloft/music and trigger a scan. Newly uploaded tracks are not found. Make sure the files are under /opt/songloft/music and readable by the container, then run the scan again. If you changed the music directory, update it on the settings page before scanning. Is data durable across restarts? Yes. Data and music live in /opt/songloft/data and /opt/songloft/music ; only releasing the instance deletes them.
